title: Karan drops 2,629.5 and the Jeremiah Fears revenge game
intro: Karan answered a bad opener with 2,629.5, the best score of the season so far, and went 9-0 against the league. Matt W beat Koren by 10.5 with help from Jeremiah Fears, a player Koren dropped that same week. Wemby scored 389 for Sean, the most by any player, and Sean still had the lowest score and lost by 445. Four teams sit at 2-0: Matt W, Ben, Max and Dean.

teams.Matt W: 2-0 and 17-1 against the whole league over two weeks. Giannis carried with 350 in three games. The winning margin over Koren was 10.5, and Jeremiah Fears, picked up after Koren dropped him, scored 62 for Matt W in that matchup. Fred VanVleet had 62 in two starts. Next up: the battle of the Matts, which Matt W leads 8-6.
teams.Ben: 2-0 with an asterisk. Ben scored 2,228, seventh best in the league, and beat Matt G by 119, which makes it the lucky win of the week. Jokic had 267.5 and Anthony Black gave him 162 off the wire. The bad news is that Ben dropped Ayo Dosunmu, and Max picked him up for 198. Sean is next.
teams.Max: 2-0 again. Cooper Flagg had 304, rookie Yaxel Lendeborg 258.5 and Maxey 236. The waiver hero of the week is Max, with Ayo Dosunmu scoring 198 the week Ben let him go, plus 167.5 from Isaiah Hartenstein. Dejounte Murray had 47 in two games. Next week is Dean, the other unbeaten team, and the series is tied 2-2.
teams.Dean: Coach of the week. Dean set the best possible lineup every single day and blew Sean out by 445, the biggest margin of the week. Steph had 277.5, Jabari Smith Jr. 267.5 and Jarrett Allen 255. Dean is 2-0 and gets Max for first place.
teams.Karan: The best score of the season, 2,629.5, and a 9-0 week against the league. Luka had 365.5 and Brandon Miller 345.5. Even this week had a blunder: Karan left 101.5 on the bench, the most in the league, with Brandin Podziemski sitting for 69.5. Still won by 362.5. Moves up four spots in the power rankings to fifth.
teams.Koren: The unluckiest team in the league. Koren is 0-2 with a 13-5 record against the whole league, and lost this week by 10.5 with the third best score. Tatum had 331.5. Embiid gave him 115.5 in three games, and the guy he dropped, Jeremiah Fears, scored 62 for the team that beat him. Next week is Mack, with both teams 0-2.
teams.Sammy: Lost to Max by 139.5 for a 1-1 start. Jalen Johnson and Jalen Brunson both cleared 235. Derik Queen had 102 in three starts. Karan is next, coming off the best week of the season.
teams.Matt G: 0-2 with the ninth best score this week. Evan Mobley had 276 and Ace Bailey was a nice pickup at 172.5, but Zach Edey had 76 in three games and Matt G churned through Pelle Larsson and Terrence Shannon Jr. without much to show. Next is Matt W.
teams.Mack: Mack scored 2,267, fifth in the league, and ran into the best score of the season. That is 0-2 with a week that beats half the league. Mack also had the most starter games in the league at 45 and the best single day of the week, 699.5 on Monday, Oct 26. Siakam had 254. Next is Koren, the other 0-2 team.
teams.Sean: Wemby scored 389 in three games, the most by any player this week, and Sean finished last in the league. Devin Booker, a third-round pick, averaged 40.5 a game, the worst of any early pick, and Lauri Markkanen had 53.5 in three. 0-9 against the league this week and a 445-point loss to Dean.

preview: Two of the four unbeaten teams meet: Dean and Max, with the series tied 2-2. Matt W and Matt G settle who the real Matt is. Mack and Koren are both 0-2 and somebody gets their first win.
